reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific, single-step ECAP intervention on AlCoCrFeNi2.1 to mitigate dislocation pile-ups and brittleness, which is not reported or suggested in any passage. While passages discuss cryo-rolling, cold-rolling, annealing, and hybrid-rolling for this alloy, none mention ECAP or its effect on semi-coherent boundaries and pile-up reduction. The mechanism linking ECAP-induced shear to reorientation of lamellae and homogenization of dislocation density is a new synthesis not found in the literature.
